As Microsoft (MSFT) Share Price Rose, Walter & Keenan Financial Consulting Company Decreased Position; As Grifols S A (GRFS) Market Value Rose, Shareholder Santa Barbara Asset Management Has Lowered by $355,425 Its Stake 
March 1, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Santa Barbara Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Grifols S A (GRFS) by 12.58% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Santa Barbara Asset Management Llc sold 16,925 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.33% with the market. The institutional investor held 117,630 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.58M, down from 134,555 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Santa Barbara Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Grifols S A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.30 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.52% or $0.55   $21.25. About 561,871 shares traded or 11.33% up from the average. Grifols, S.A. (NASDAQ:GRFS) has risen 47.59%   outperformed by 30.89% the S&P500. 
Walter & Keenan Financial Consulting Company decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 4.45% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Walter & Keenan Financial Consulting Company sold 4,199 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.75% with the market. The institutional investor held 90,119 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.71 million, down from 94,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Walter & Keenan Financial Consulting Company who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $717.97 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.56% or $0.525   $93.245. About 9.92M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 34.52%   outperformed by 17.82% the S&P500. 
Among 5 analysts covering Grifols SA ( NASDAQ:GRFS ), 3 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 60% are positive. Grifols SA had 7   August 17,   The firm earned “Overweight” rating on Tuesday, January 3 by JP Morgan. The stock of Grifols, S.A. (NASDAQ:GRFS) earned “Hold” rating by HSBC on Wednesday, December 2. Berenberg upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Tuesday, February 9 report. On Monday, January 4 the stock rating was downgraded by Morgan Stanley to “Underweight”. The stock has “Buy” rating by Nomura on Thursday, March 17. The firm has “Hold” rating by Berenberg given on Friday, November 20. 
Santa Barbara Asset Management Llc, which manages about $4.47 billion and $6.28B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Praxair Inc (NYSE:PX) by 118,253 shares to 1.14M shares, valued at $158.97M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,214 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.72M shares, and has risen its stake in Mondelez Intl Inc (NASDAQ:MDLZ). 
Since August 29, 2017, it had 0 buys, and 2 selling transactions for $605,412 activity. $279,912 worth of stock was sold by Capossela Christopher C on Friday, February 16. $4.00M worth of Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) was sold by Hood Amy on Tuesday, August 29.

MSFT’s profit will be $6.54B for 27.43 P/E if the $0.85 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.96 actual EPS reported by Microsoft Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -11.46% negative EPS growth.
